newsitem.title: ITALY: IRI studying Autostrade sale timing.
newsitem.headline: IRI studying Autostrade sale timing.

text.p: Italian industrial holding IRI is still considering the timing of its privatisation of motorway operator Autostrade and no decision has been taken on whether to delay it, company sources said on Tuesday.

"No decision has been taken on a possible delay to September of the Autostrade sale," one source said, noting media reports that had suggested that the sale could slip because of the Treasury's decision to offer a third tranche in energy group ENI Ente Nazionale Idrocarburi late in June.
The sale of Autostrade, which is 87 percent owned by IRI, was due to have been launched by June 30.
The IRI source said the company was still working on plans to sell the motorway group by that date.
